# Output template placeholders

Names usable in braces in the `file_options.dir_format`, `file_options.file_format`
and `metadata` templates, and in text file names
(`ofscraper/classes/placeholder.py`). Each column says which template gets the
name. Templates are filled with Python's `str.format`, so object values allow
attribute or key access: `{modelObj.name}`, `{args.posts}`, and, because
`config` is a plain dict, `{config[file_options][date]}`.

- Profile media (avatar, header) ignore `file_format` and are saved as
  `<file_name>.<ext>`.
- When `FILE_COUNT_PLACEHOLDER` is on (the default) and `file_format` uses none
  of `filename`, `only_file_name`, `original_filename` or `media_id`, a post
  with several media, or a story or highlight, gets `_<count>` before the
  extension.
- On Fansly, if the `metadata` template uses none of `save_location`, `root`,
  `site_name` or `model_id` (or their aliases), the site name is added as a
  subfolder so Fansly rows don't share an OnlyFans `user_data.db`.
- The validators in `ofscraper/prompts/prompt_validators.py` aren't called
  anywhere, and accept only some of these names.

| Placeholder | Also | Database path (`metadata`) | Media folders (`dir_format`) | Media file names (`file_format`) | Text files (`--text`) | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `{args}` |  |  | yes | yes | yes | Object: the parsed command-line arguments (an AutoDotDict), usable with attribute access, e.g. {args.posts}; a missing name gives None. |
| `{config}` |  |  | yes | yes | yes | Object: the parsed config.json as a dict, so use item syntax, e.g. {config[file_options][date]}; attribute access does not work. |
| `{config_path}` | `{configpath}` | yes | yes | yes | yes | The config home folder (common_paths.get_config_home(), e.g. {home_directory}/.config/ofscraper); usually written {configpath}, which is how the default metadata path uses it. |
| `{current_price}` | `{currentprice}` |  | yes | yes | yes | 'Free' if the creator's final current price is 0, else 'Paid'; MODEL_PRICE_PLACEHOLDER ('Unknown_Price' by default) when the model isn't loaded. |
| `{date}` |  |  | yes | yes | yes | The post's date (postedAt, else createdAt) formatted with the file_options.date config (arrow tokens, default MM-DD-YYYY). |
| `{download_type}` | `{downloadtype}` |  | yes | yes |  | 'Protected' for DRM (MPD) media, 'Normal' otherwise. |
| `{ext}` |  |  |  | yes | yes | The file extension without the dot, e.g. mp4, jpg; 'txt' for text files. |
| `{file_name}` | `{filename}` |  | yes | yes | yes | Final media file name without extension: the name from the media URL, the media id if none, videos with _<quality> appended, cleaned and with spaces replaced by space_replacer; for text files the sanitised, truncated post text. Usually written {filename} (the default file_format is {filename}.{ext}). |
| `{first_letter}` | `{firstletter}` | yes | yes | yes | yes | First letter of the creator's username, upper-cased, e.g. 'A'. |
| `{label}` |  |  | yes | yes | yes | The post's label name, or the string 'None' when it has no label. |
| `{media_id}` | `{mediaid}` |  | yes | yes |  | Id of the media item; including it (or a filename field) in file_format stops the automatic _<count> suffix. |
| `{media_type}` | `{mediatype}` |  | yes | yes | yes | Capitalised media kind: Images, Videos (gifs count as Videos), Audios, Forced_skipped, or 'Text' for text files; usually written {mediatype}. |
| `{modelObj}` |  |  | yes | yes | yes | Object: the creator's model (ofscraper/classes/of/models.py) from the model manager, used with attribute access, e.g. {modelObj.name}, {modelObj.id}, {modelObj.final_current_price}; None if the creator isn't loaded, so attribute access then fails. |
| `{model_id}` | `{modelid}` | yes | yes | yes | yes | The creator's numeric account id (OnlyFans ids are short; Fansly ids are 18-digit snowflakes). Default metadata path is {configpath}/{profile}/.data/{model_id}. |
| `{model_username}` | `{modelusername}` | yes | yes | yes | yes | The creator's username (lower-cased by the media/post objects for dir and file names). |
| `{my_id}` | `{myid}` | yes | yes | yes | yes | The logged-in account's numeric id; 'anon' in anonymous mode. |
| `{my_username}` | `{myusername}` | yes | yes | yes | yes | Username of the logged-in account; 'anon' in anonymous mode. |
| `{only_file_name}` | `{onlyfilename}` |  | yes | yes | yes | Like {file_name} but without the video quality suffix; for text files the sanitised post text. |
| `{only_filename}` | `{onlyfilename}` |  | yes | yes | yes | Same value as {only_file_name}. |
| `{original_filename}` | `{originalfilename}` |  | yes | yes | yes | File name taken from the media URL (the raw media filename, None when the media has no URL); for text files the sanitised post text. |
| `{post_id}` | `{postid}` |  | yes | yes | yes | Id of the post or message the media belongs to (for text files, the post's own id). |
| `{profile}` |  | yes | yes | yes | yes | Name of the active profile, e.g. main_profile. |
| `{promo_price}` | `{promoprice}` |  | yes | yes | yes | 'Free' or 'Paid' from the creator's final promo price, or MODEL_PRICE_PLACEHOLDER. |
| `{quality}` |  |  | yes | yes | yes | Selected video quality such as 1080, 720, 240 or 'source'; non-videos and text files are 'source' (QUALITY_UNKNOWN_DEFAULT when unknown). |
| `{regular_price}` | `{regularprice}` |  | yes | yes | yes | 'Free' or 'Paid' from the creator's final regular price, or MODEL_PRICE_PLACEHOLDER. |
| `{renewal_price}` | `{renewalprice}` |  | yes | yes | yes | 'Free' or 'Paid' from the creator's final renewal price, or MODEL_PRICE_PLACEHOLDER. |
| `{response_type}` | `{responsetype}` |  | yes | yes | yes | Display name of the content area from the responsetype config map (defaults Posts, Messages, Archived, Stories, Profile, Streams; timeline and pinned map to Posts, paid to Messages, highlights to Stories); archived posts use the configured Archived name; usually written {responsetype}. |
| `{root}` |  | yes | yes | yes | yes | Pathlib.Path of {save_location} (the media root, Fansly subfolder included). |
| `{save_location}` | `{savelocation}` | yes | yes | yes | yes | The configured save location; on Fansly runs it is '<save location>/Fansly'. Same value as {root} but as the configured string. |
| `{site_name}` | `{sitename}` | yes | yes | yes | yes | Name of the site being scraped (sites.site_name()), e.g. the Fansly name on Fansly runs; usually written {sitename}. |
| `{text}` |  |  | yes | yes | yes | For media: the post text cleaned and truncated to textlength (falls back to the file name, the date, or the media id). For text files: the sanitised, truncated post text. |
| `{user_name}` | `{username}` |  | yes | yes | yes | The creator's username (same as {model_username}); its alias {username} also works. |
| `{username}` |  | yes |  |  |  | The creator's username. In dir_format, file_format and text files it also exists, as the underscore-free alias of {user_name} (same value). |
| `{value}` |  |  | yes | yes | yes | 'Free' or 'Paid', from the post's price (0 means Free). |

The underscore-free form is added for every name with an underscore (`add_no_underline`).
